title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
source: Recording Info: Recorded by Kidd at the soundboard - MAR > R > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: High‑energy free‑form jam captured in a surprisingly clear audience recording
ai_review.review: The three reviewers are uniformly enthusiastic, praising the vividness of the improvisation and the overall sound quality. While two simply call it “incredible” or “awesome,” one notes that the typical audience chatter fades during the extended jam, letting the music shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and highlight a standout improvisational segment; the recording is described as clear for an audience source, giving a solid combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note that crowd clapping and chatter largely disappear during the jam, allowing the instruments to be heard clearly; overall fidelity is high enough for a FLAC24 release.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set builds into an expansive jam that shifts gears around the 11‑minute mark, with the band’s focus so intense that audience noise subsides.
